# Cybertron Shifted

Cybertron Shifted is a dark theme derived from Cybertron with adjusted colors and subtle interface tweaks for readability and visual consistency. It preserves the Cybertron aesthetic while restyling panes, the editor and code blocks.

![Cybertron Shifted screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jorgedmundo/cybertron-shifted/HEAD/CybertronShifted.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cybertron Shifted"
    author: "jorgedmundo"
    repo:   "jorgedmundo/cybertron-shifted"
    slug:   "cybertron-shifted"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cybertron-shifted"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jorgedmundo/cybertron-shifted"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jorgedmundo/cybertron-shifted/HEAD/CybertronShifted.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Cybertron-inspired dark theme with adjusted colors and subtle UI tweaks for improved readability and visual consistency. Preserve Cybertron's aesthetic while introducing personalized styling for panes, editor, and code blocks."
}
```
